title.en: An Act Establishing a National High School in Barangay Maac, Municipality of Guinsiliban, Province of Camiguin to Be Known as Maac National High School and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Establishing a National High School in Barangay Maac, Municipality of Guinsiliban, Province of Camiguin to Be Known as Maac National High School and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật thành lập Trường trung học phổ thông quốc gia tại Barangay Maac, Thị trấn Guinsiliban, Tỉnh Camiguin được biết đến với tên gọi Trường trung học phổ thông quốc gia Maac
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติจัดตั้งโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาตอนปลายแห่งชาติในบารังไกย์ Maac, เทศบาล Guinsiliban, จังหวัด Camiguin ให้เป็นที่รู้จักในชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาตอนปลายแห่งชาติ Maac
title.id: Undang-Undang mendirikan Sekolah Menengah Atas Nasional di Barangay Maac, Kotamadya Guinsiliban, Provinsi Camiguin dikenal sebagai Sekolah Menengah Atas Nasional Maac

text.en: Establishment of a National High School. - There is hereby established, under the supervision of the Department of Education, a national high school in Barangay Maac, Municipality of Guinsiliban, Province of Camiguin to be known as Maac National High School.

Appropriations. - The Secretary of Education shall immediately include in the Department's program the operationalization of Maac National High School, the funding of which shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
Implementation. - The Secretary of Education shall issue such rules and regulations as may be necessary to carry out the purpose of this Act.
Effectivity. - This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette.
